4th Period.weeklyDeliverable: Turned in Sunday night: your Juice doc (game link, the juice you added, 2 answers) and the juice working in your live game.
4th Period.workingNow: Open the Google Classroom assignment called Juice Week. Fill in the Answers tab, play classmates' games, vote, and turn in once at the end of class.
4th Period.smartGoal: By the end of class, I can explain how my juice makes my game feel more responsive, give feedback on 2 classmates' games, and turn in once.
4th Period.contentStandard: CA CS Standards 6-8.AP.15 — Seek and incorporate feedback from team members and users to refine a solution that meets user needs.
4th Period.eldStandard: ELD.PI.6-8.3 — Offering and supporting opinions and negotiating with others in communicative exchanges.
agenda: Blooket quiz (5 min)
Review quiz answers + today's goal (5 min)
Finish + fill in the Answers tab (12 min)
Juice judges: play 2 games, give feedback (14 min)
DONUTS vote: best game, top 3 (6 min)
Final check + turn in (8 min)
4th Period.connections: This week you added juice so every paddle hit feels responsive. Today you judge classmates' juice, vote for the best game, and turn in once. The winners play on DONUTS Tuesday. Next week: the Iterator pattern.

6th Period.weeklyDeliverable: Turned in Sunday night: your group's Answers page with a photo of where your bridge broke, your prediction, the pounds it held when it broke, and why it broke there.

agenda: Blooket quiz (5 min)
Review quiz answers + today's goal (5 min)
Roles + post your prediction on the board (4 min)
BREAK TEST: add 8 and 10 lb dumbbells one at a time until it breaks. Holds all 36 lb? Someone stands on it! (16 min)
Class data: predictions vs. breaks (6 min)
Answers page: where it broke and why (9 min)
Turn in on Google Classroom (5 min)
6th Period.connections: These two weeks you built, tested, and fixed a cardboard bridge. Today you break it on purpose, compare every group's results, and turn in once. If your bridge holds all 36 lb, a student stands on it, and the video goes on DONUTS.
